a: Yazaalibwa mu 1897 mu maka ga Buganda agaamanyibwa, n'asoma bulungi mu Mengo High School ne mu King's College, Budo, era n'aweebwa ekitiibwa olw'obuweereza obw'ekitalo mu African Native Medical Corps mu Lutalo olw'Ensi Yonna olw'Olubereberye. Oluvannyuma yalinnya mu gavumenti y'obwakabaka bwa Buganda ng'omukungu w'ebyobulamu mu Kampala, ng'assibwamu ekitiibwa era ng'ali mu bukuumi, era yali Mukristaayo eyabatizibwa mu Kkanisa ya Uganda (ey'Abaanglikani). Abakugu mu byafaayo bamujjukira, mu ngeri nnyingi, nga kitaawe w'ekibiina kyonna ekya Balokole.

Mu buli ngeri ey'okungulu Nsibambi yali atuuse — ng'asomye, ng'alina ebintu, era ng'omukulembeze mu kkanisa y'abantu be — naye yalina munda ye obutateredde obutaali na kitiibwa kyonna kiyinza kukkakkanya. Yeetunuulira era n'atunuulira ekkanisa eyamwetooloola, n'alaba okukkiriza okwali okutuufu naye nga kwa mpewo, eddiini ey'enkola ezitaliimu muliro. Yalina obubonero obw'okungulu obw'Omukristaayo n'enjala ey'omunda ey'omuntu amanyi nti ekikulu akibuze, era okusaba kwe kwe kwali okusaba okusinga obukadde okw'omwoyo oguzuukuse: waateekwa okubaawo ekirala; kimpe.

q: Kiki ekyabaawo ku Lusozi Namirembe mu Ssebutemba 1929?
a: Ku Ssande yasisinkana Dr. Joe Church, omuminsani w'ebyobujjanjabi eyali akooye era ng'awummulako mu Kampala, ku kkanisa ennene, n'amunyigiriza n'ekibuuzo ekyali kimwokya mu kifuba kye: kiki ekyali kibuze, mu kkanisa ne mu ye yennyini? Mu nkomerero y'ewiiki eyo abasajja bombi baatuula wamu nga Bayibuli eggule, nga bakenneenya Ebyawandiikibwa n'ebiwandiiko bya Scofield ebikwata ku kujjuzibwa Omwoyo, era ne basaba okuteeka wansi buli kibi kye baali bamanyi n'okujjuzibwa. Tekyali kya kusomesa, wabula baali basajja babiri abalina enjala abajjira wamu eri Katonda nga bakalu ne bajjuzibwa.

q: Joe Church yali ani, era yaleeta ki?
a: Joe Church yali muminsani w'ebyobujjanjabi owa Ruanda Mission, eyaddukanyanga eddwaliro e Gahini, era naye yali atuuse ku nkomerero y'amaanyi ge — ng'akaze mu mwoyo era ng'aggwaamu essuubi — era yali agenze e Kampala okumala ennaku ntono okuwummula. Okuva mu kuyigiriza okw'"obulamu obuwangula" kwe yali anywedde mu nkuŋŋaana za Keswick, yabuulira Nsibambi ku kujjula kw'Omwoyo Omutukuvu ne ku bulamu obw'Ekikristaayo obutambulirwamu mu buwanguzi mu kifo ky'okuwangulwa, era n'addayo e Gahini, ng'ebyafaayo bwe bigamba, mu maanyi ga Pentekooti.

q: Obulamu bwe bwakyuka butya oluvannyuma lw'enkomerero y'ewiiki eyo?
a: Enkyukakyuka yali njijjuvu, era eri baliraanwa be ab'ekitiibwa yali ya ntiisa. Yaleka omulimu gwe ogwa gavumenti n'obukuumi bwe gwaleeta, ne yeewaayo kyokka eri okusaba n'okubuulira, ng'ayimirira ku Lusozi Namirembe ne ku nsonda z'enguudo ezaali okumpi n'ekkanisa ennene, ng'ayita abasajja n'abakazi eri okumenyeka kw'omutima, okwatula n'obulamu obuggya. Yali akwatiddeko ku kintu kye yali ayaayaanira ebbanga lyonna, era kaakano teyasobola kukikuuma munda ye.

Yafuuka omusajja atayinza kusisinkana mugenyi nga tamubuuzza ku mwoyo gwe, ng'ayimiriza abantu ku luguudo, mu katale ne ku mulyango okubabuuza mu bwerufu oba baali balokolebwa — okubuulira okukwata omuntu kinnoomu okuswaza ab'empisa ennungi ne kununula ababuze. Joe Church bwe yadda e Kampala, omuminsani eyali anyiize yeemulugunya nti: "Ayi, agudde eddalu era abuna wonna ng'abuuza abantu oba balokolebwa. Aakava ku mulimi wange ow'olusuku." Tekyali ddalu, wabula yali musajja eyali akkirizza enjiri ye ye ku nkomerero.

q: Yakola ki mu Kuzuukuka okugazi okw'Afirika ey'Obuvanjuba?
a: Okuva ku nkomerero y'ewiiki eyo emu ey'okwewaayo omuliro gwabuna ebweru — ne gutuuka mu Rwanda, mu Uganda, era mu kiseera ne gubuna Kenya, Tanzania ne Burundi — okutuusa okuzuukuka okujjukirwa kaakano nga Okuzuukuka kw'Afirika ey'Obuvanjuba lwe kwatuuka ku bantu obukadde n'obukadde. Abantu baakwo be balokole, "abaalokolebwa", abaafuula ekigambo kyabwe eky'okulanga oluyimba olw'Oluganda "Tukutendereza Yesu". Mu bakulembeze abaava mu kwo mwalimu Ssaabalabirizi Erica Sabiti, Omulabirizi Festo Kivengere, ne Ssaabalabirizi Janani Luwum eyattibwa olw'okukkiriza.

Nsibambi yakulembera muto we, Blasio Kigozi, okutuuka mu kukkiriza okulamu. Kigozi yeegatta ku Joe Church e Gahini n'afuuka omubuulizi w'enjiri ayaka ku bubwe nga tannafa ng'akyali muto mu 1936, era Nsibambi ye yamuziika ku Cathedral Hill. Kyali kyokulabirako kimu ku nkola engazi: omuliro ogwakoleezebwa mu ye gwasooka kubuna mu abo abaali okumpi naye, n'oluvannyuma ne gugenda wala nnyo.

q: Kiki ekyali eky'enjawulo mu myaka gye egy'oluvannyuma?
a: Awo nga mu 1941 obulamu bwe bwakendeera, era okuva olwo n'abeera nga yeeyawula okusingawo, ng'asigala emirundi mingi mu maka ge okumpi n'Ekkanisa Enkulu ey'e Namirembe. Eri omukulembeze w'okuzuukuka okunene ng'okwo kyandirabise ng'okusirisibwa okw'obukambwe, naye omusajja eyali ayimirizza abagenyi ku luguudo yafuuka ensulo y'okwegayiririra abalala — ng'asembeza abo abajja gy'ali era ng'awanirira mu kusaba abakulembeze abo amannya gaabwe agaali gagenda okumanyibwa mu nsi yonna. Yafa mu 1978, ng'akaddiye era, mu ngeri esinga obwesimbu, nga jjajja w'olulyo lw'abakkiriza.

Ayigiriza ekkanisa essomo lye terekera ddala kwerabira: nti okuzuukuka tekutandikira mu nteekateeka wabula mu kwewaayo, si mu bibiina binene wabula mu bakkiriza babiri abalina enjala abatayimuka ku maviivi gaabwe okutuusa Katonda lw'abajjuza. Omusajja omugagga eyalonda okuba omwavu ku lwa Kristo, omukungu eyassibwamu ekitiibwa eyakkiriza okulowoozebwa nti agudde eddalu, teyayagala kintu kirala nga bwe yayagala okuba omutukuvu — era okuva mu kwewaayo kumu ng'okwo, ku lusozi erinnya lyalwo erikitegeeza olujjudde emirembe, emirembe gya Katonda ne gigenda mu ssemazinga.
